content.text: The text surveys intestinal cancer, lardaceous degeneration, rectal and anal diseases, intestinal parasites, and liver disorders. It describes symptoms, pathology, diagnosis, prognosis, treatment, and prevention of cancers, strictures, hemorrhoids, fissures, ulcers, abscesses, fistulas, prolapse, impaction, worms, trichinosis, jaundice, hepatic congestion, perihepatitis, and cirrhosis. Emphasis is placed on historical nineteenth-century surgical and medicinal practices, including diet, laxatives, enemas, cautery, dilation, excision, colotomy, and parasite control through sanitation, filtration, and thoroughly cooked food. It also discusses bile metabolism, uric-acid excess, glycosuria, and alcohol, infection, obstruction, and dietary causes of liver disease. John journeyed to the bedroom.
